Football for everyone

Eleven programs, from under 4s to over 40s. Whoever your customers are, they're at our club.

VPL One in 2027

Senior Men

Our senior men play in Victorian Premier League One in 2027, with U23 and U19 squads behind them.

VPL One in 2027

Senior Women

Our senior women play in Victorian Premier League One in 2027, backed by a full reserves squad.

Elite boys pathway

VYPL Boys

Our elite boys compete in Division One of Football Victoria's Victorian Youth Premier League.

Elite girls pathway

VYPL Girls

Our elite girls compete in the Girls Victorian Youth Premier League, the top junior competition for girls in the state.

Under 4s to under 7s

MiniTillies & Kickstart

Fun first touches for our youngest players, building skills and confidence in small groups.

Girls under 7s to under 18s

MiniRoos & Community Female

Girls-only teams from their first game through to junior community football, plus our weekend girls' academy.

Boys under 7s to under 18s

MiniRoos & Community Male

Hundreds of local boys playing every weekend across our junior community teams.

Under 4s to under 30s

All Abilities

Football for players of every ability. In 2025 we ran 40 sessions and 3 gala days.

Social football for mums

Soccer Mums

A relaxed, social way for mums to get active and part of the club, no experience needed.

Social football

Over 40s Men

Social football for men over 40 who still love a weekly game.

Cups and carnivals

Tournaments @ MUFC

We host the Junior Boys Cup, the Junior Girls Cup and the Female Football Shield, drawing hundreds of families.

Your brand, front and centre

Every placement is seen by families every week. Here's exactly where your logo goes.

Jersey front

The biggest spot in the club. Front and centre in every match, team photo and match-day post, for our men's or women's program.

Jersey back

Top back or bottom back, framing the player number. Seen by every family on the sideline, every week.

Jersey sleeve

Left or right sleeve, sitting beside the club crest in every close-up and player graphic we post.

Shorts front

Left or right front of the shorts, moving with the play in every action shot.

Shorts back

Left or right back of the shorts, on show every time the team huddles or turns to defend.

Club training jacket

Front or back of the club jacket, worn by our elite and senior players at training and arriving on game day.

Coach & team manager wear

Polos, zip-ups and hoodies worn by coaches and team managers across all 68 teams, all season.

Pitch banners

$3,000 for one ground, or $5,000 across all of them: Pettys Reserve, Timber Ridge and Wilsons Road Reserve, seen by around 1,500 visitors every game day.

Kit bags

Your logo on player and team kit bags, carried to training, to school and to every game.

Every placement, with pricing, is set out under Ways to partner.

A club that wins

Crowned at the Premier Data Victorian Club State Championships, run by Football Victoria. The title recognises the whole club, from MiniRoos to seniors.

15s CPL Premiers

Girls Community Premier League, 2026.

Women's State League 3 Champions

Nike Cup

Won five games in 2025 and finished as the highest-placed community team.

Steph Catley Cup

Runners-up in the Victorian final, 2025.

VPL One, men and women

Both our senior men and senior women play in Victorian Premier League One in 2027. Our men also played two Australia Cup games in 2025.

Youth Premier League Division One

Our elite boys qualified for Football Victoria's new top youth competition in 2026.
